run_make_changelog: run the make_changelog script to generate a changelog from pybind11 GitHub issues with the needs changelog label
extract_changelog_entries: extract suggested changelog entries from GitHub issue bodies using the MD_ENTRY regex pattern
categorize_issues: categorize closed GitHub issues into feat, fix, docs, tests, ci, or chore categories by title prefix
find_missing_changelog_issues: find and report GitHub issues that are missing a suggested changelog entry section
find_old_rst_issues: find and report GitHub issues that use the old RST changelog format instead of markdown
